name: KinoCheck
description: Movie and show trailers listed by KinoCheck (api.kinocheck.com), looked up by TMDB or IMDb id only. Trailers play in YouTube's official embedded player; Cinema never downloads or extracts them. No key needed (about 1000 lookups a day); a KinoCheck API key raises that.

settings.label: API host (only with a key, if KinoCheck gave you one)
